correctness.rationale: For each nondecreasing word-map f, f(S) is a singleton iff f(min S)=f(max S), so reduce each subset to one of n(n+1)/2 ordered pairs. Inspected frozen census.cpp (blob 4bca34cd5dc132bf86d057e5252e9b6a36195cd1): enumerates all C(2n-1,n) monotone maps, every unordered pair of letter maps, forms exact inverse pair-state transitions, and reverse-BFS layers from every diagonal. The program asserts 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9 for n=1..9 and exactly two unordered normalized n9 extremals, hence four ordered. Independent Python reverse pair BFS checked the enumeration mechanism exhaustively for n<=5, and independent forward BFS for the explicit n9 maps from (1,6) returned shortest word babbaabbb length 9. N9 full 590976100 ordered-pair computation was inspected but not independently rerun: no false claim of its execution. Its complete source loops provide a bounded finite exhaustive certificate, beyond finite extrapolation.
